saw_lines: Bedding is bought by feel and look, then replaced only when it wears out or the bedroom gets redone.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides if the look is worth a click.
Your 0 of 11 ads are video, so nobody sees the bedding in use. Shoot three short videos of the set on a made bed then run them first.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 11 ads are video, so nobody sees the muslin move or fall across a bed before they click. Shoot three short videos of the set on a made bed, then run them against your best image ad.

None of your 11 ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has no count to trust before the price. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

9 of 11 ads are catalog feed cards with no story, so the product shows up with no reason to stop. Add three story ads that open on a real bedroom and explain the fabric, then run them beside the feed.
0 of 2 ads carry an offer so a new buyer has no reason to act. Give new buyers one reason to buy, a first order discount or a bundle, and put it in the first line of the next batch.

ads_1: Muslin bedding video stories, led by a first order offer and a proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
